Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics

Record Class CosmeticState

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics.CosmeticState
Record Components:
cosmetic - the cosmetic
owned - whether the player owns it, permanently or for a limited time
unlocked - whether the player may use it: owning it, holding its permission, or, for a class or an addon's cosmetic, needing neither
selected - whether it is the player's stored choice
equipped - whether it is in effect for the player
expiry - when a cosmetic owned for a limited time expires, or null
purchasable - whether it is for sale and the player cannot use it yet
affordable - whether it is purchasable and the player's balance, as last read, covers it
public record CosmeticState(@NotNull Cosmetic cosmetic, boolean owned, boolean unlocked, boolean selected, boolean equipped, @Nullable Instant expiry, boolean purchasable, boolean affordable) extends Record
Where one online player stands with one cosmetic, as last read. A snapshot.

Selected is the player's stored choice; equipped is what is in effect: the choice while the player can still use it, otherwise the type's default. A player who chose nothing has the default equipped without having selected it.

Since:
1.11.0
